local_contribution: Evaluate an asymmetric one-parameter subfamily of the imported monotones on the paired source and matrix targets; derive exact finite repair inequalities, exclusion of every fixed subquadratic scalar repair in the formal calculus, and a natural-logarithm coefficient with a dimension-loss refinement. A uniform source lower bound valid in both generator branches and an entropy-ratio inequality then prove sharpness over the entire external F_theta family, including parameters approaching the simplex corners. The logarithmic-loss sharpness statement assumes the scaled product deficit has a finite limit. This does not prove sufficiency of a formal repair or optimality over all formal monotones.
